summary: The US Department of Defense certification required to hold contracts involving FCI or CUI, per 32 CFR Part 170. Three independent tiers: level1 (15 basic safeguarding requirements, self-assessed), level2 (all 110 NIST SP 800-171 R2 requirements, C3PAO-assessed) and level3 (24 enhanced requirements from NIST SP 800-172, DIBCAC-assessed, and it presupposes level2). The only module whose requirement text ships verbatim — US Government works carry no copyright — and the only one that deliberately tracks a withdrawn NIST revision, because that is the one the regulation binds.
